title: Raise an existing exhaustion level atomically (rule:food, rule:water, rule:speed)
description:
Problem. SRD rule:food ('suffers one level of exhaustion' per day beyond the limit), rule:water (one level, or two levels if the character already has exhaustion) and rule:speed Forced March (one level per failed save) impose ADDITIONAL exhaustion levels. add_condition (characters) and update_combatant addCondition (combatants) are no-ops on an existing condition id (domainMutations.ts addCondition; encounterCombatants.ts), and rest.ts requires {id:'exhaustion', level:1..6}. No tool raises an existing level, so the state cannot be persisted; removing and re-adding with a model-computed level is forbidden (model arithmetic, non-atomic). Current disclosure: RULE_KNOWN_LIMITS rule:food / rule:water / rule:speed with capability gap 'graded-exhaustion-increase'.

Required capability. Operation: add N exhaustion levels (N >= 1, source-declared: 1, or 2 for rule:water when already exhausted) to a character or combatant atomically; absent -> level N; cap and level-6 consequence per condition:exhaustion (death at 6) handled by the engine, not the DM. Inputs: target identity, N. Exclusions: whether the rule's trigger occurred (DM). Long-rest reduction stays in rest.ts and must interoperate.

Selection basis: the governing SRD clause requires an engine-owned step (ADR 0020 §3: arithmetic / atomic state mutation / resource accounting / lifecycle), and no registered tool performs it. Under F-09 design amendment A5 (docs/design/rule-record-runtime-statements.md, PR #596) the rule's known limit only DISCLOSES this gap; it does not satisfy or retire the obligation. This bead blocks eshyra-o9bd.19.3.4 (owning rules work for opus:F-09 / sol:CAP-001) until the capability lands or accepted authority explicitly changes the requirement. Do not close it because PR #596 recorded the gap. Enters this engine family by explicit positive selection (the family's out-of-backlog entry clause).
acceptance_criteria:
- Deterministic level increase for characters and encounter combatants, atomic, with level-6 death handled by the engine.
- Tests: absent->N, k->k+N, cap/death at 6, long-rest reduction interop, combatant parity.
- The three known limits rewritten or retired under R0 and their gap entries removed from ENGINE_CAPABILITY_GAPS; add_condition description updated.
- eshyra-o9bd.19.3.4 dependency resolves only when this lands.
